## List Contract Invoices

Retrieves a paginated list of all invoices associated with a specific contract. The response includes invoice details such as amounts, status, and payment dates, along with pagination metadata.

---

## Path Variables

| Variable | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | The unique ID of the contract whose invoices you want to retrieve. |

---

## Response Fields

### `data[]` — Invoice Object

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | Unique identifier of the invoice. |
| `invoice_number` | string | Human-readable invoice number (e.g. `INV-003-202602-7396`). |
| `subtotal` | string | The pre-tax subtotal amount. |
| `tax_amount` | string | The tax amount applied to the invoice. |
| `total` | string | The final total amount of the invoice. |
| `status` | string | Current status of the invoice (e.g. `pending`, `paid`, `cancelled`). |
| `due_date` | string (date) | The date by which the invoice is due (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `paid_at` | string (date) | The date the invoice was paid (`YYYY-MM-DD`), or `null` if unpaid. |

### `meta` — Pagination Metadata

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `total` | integer | Total number of records matching the query. |
| `current_page` | integer | The current page number. |
| `per_page` | integer | Number of records returned per page. |
| `last_page` | integer | The last available page number. |

---

## Example Response

``` json
{
  "message": "Contract Invoices",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "invoice_number": "INV-003-202602-7396",
      "subtotal": "4671.74",
      "tax_amount": "2875.12",
      "total": "843.04",
      "status": "cancelled",
      "due_date": "1973-02-25",
      "paid_at": "1999-04-09"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "invoices_count": 1,
    "total": 1,
    "current_page": 1,
    "per_page": 10,
    "last_page": 1
  }
}

 ```

## Get Invoice Details

Retrieves the full details of a specific invoice, including its financial breakdown and a list of all associated payments.

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `{{base_url}}invoices/:id`

---

## Path Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | ✅ Yes | The unique identifier of the invoice to retrieve. |

---

## Headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| `Accept` | `application/json` | Specifies that the response should be returned in JSON format. |

---

## Response — `200 OK`

Returns a JSON object containing the invoice details along with its payment history.

### Top-Level Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `message` | string | A human-readable message describing the response (e.g., `"Invoice Details with Payments"`). |
| `data` | object | The invoice object containing all details and payments. |

### `data` Object

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Unique identifier of the invoice. |
| `invoice_number` | string | The formatted invoice number (e.g., `INV-003-202602-7396`). |
| `subtotal` | string | The pre-tax subtotal amount of the invoice. |
| `tax_amount` | string | The tax amount applied to the invoice. |
| `total` | string | The final total amount of the invoice after all adjustments. |
| `status` | string | Current status of the invoice. Possible values include `cancelled`, `paid`, `pending`, etc. |
| `due_date` | string (date) | The date by which the invoice payment is due (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `paid_at` | string (date) | The date the invoice was marked as paid (`YYYY-MM-DD`). `null` if not yet paid. |
| `payments` | array | A list of payment transactions associated with this invoice. |

### `data.payments[]` Object

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Unique identifier of the payment record. |
| `amount` | string | The amount paid in this transaction. |
| `payment_method` | string | The method used for payment (e.g., `bank_transfer`, `cash`, `credit_card`). |
| `reference_number` | string | A unique reference number for tracking the payment transaction. |
| `paid_at` | string (date) | The date this specific payment was made (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |

---

## Example Response

```json
{
  "message": "Invoice Details with Payments",
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "invoice_number": "INV-003-202602-7396",
    "subtotal": "4671.74",
    "tax_amount": "2875.12",
    "total": "843.04",
    "status": "cancelled",
    "due_date": "1973-02-25",
    "paid_at": "1999-04-09",
    "payments": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "amount": "3993.79",
        "payment_method": "bank_transfer",
        "reference_number": "fpC1EnQDCenthSuWklq9",
        "paid_at": "2013-10-01"
      },
      {
        "id": 3,
        "amount": "383.28",
        "payment_method": "cash",
        "reference_number": "zRlVnaPriAf4Ehc4BMJl",
        "paid_at": "2021-03-20"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Create Invoice

Creates a new invoice for a specific contract. The endpoint calculates the tax amount and total automatically based on the provided subtotal.

---

### Path Variables

| Variable | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | The unique identifier of the contract for which the invoice is being created. |

---

### Request Body

The request body must be sent as raw JSON with the `Content-Type: application/json` header.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `subtotal` | number | ✅ Yes | The pre-tax amount for the invoice. |
| `due_date` | string (date) | ✅ Yes | The due date for the invoice payment in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. |

**Example Request Body:**
```json
{
  "subtotal": 1000,
  "due_date": "2026-02-27"
}
```

---

### Response

**Status: `201 Created`**

Returns a success message along with the newly created invoice details.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `message` | string | A confirmation message indicating the invoice was created successfully. |
| `data.id` | integer | The unique identifier of the created invoice. |
| `data.invoice_number` | string | The auto-generated invoice number (e.g., `INV-001-202602-7397`). |
| `data.subtotal` | string | The pre-tax amount of the invoice. |
| `data.tax_amount` | string | The calculated tax amount applied to the subtotal. |
| `data.total` | string | The total amount due, including tax (`subtotal + tax_amount`). |
| `data.status` | string | The current status of the invoice (e.g., `pending`, `paid`). |
| `data.due_date` | string (date) | The due date for the invoice payment. |
| `data.paid_at` | string \| null | The timestamp when the invoice was paid, or `null` if not yet paid. |

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "Invoice is created successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 12,
    "invoice_number": "INV-001-202602-7397",
    "subtotal": "1000.00",
    "tax_amount": "175.00",
    "total": "1175.00",
    "status": "pending",
    "due_date": "2026-02-27",
    "paid_at": null
  }
}
```

## Record Payment

Records a payment against a specific invoice. On success, the payment details are persisted and returned along with a confirmation message.

---

### Path Variable

| Variable | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | The unique identifier of the invoice to record the payment for. **Example:** `2` |

---

### Request Headers

| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| `Accept` | `application/json` |

---

### Request Body

Send a JSON object with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `amount` | number | The payment amount. **Example:** `1684.51` |
| `payment_method` | string | The method used for payment (e.g., `cash`, `credit_card`, `bank_transfer`). **Example:** `"cash"` |
| `reference_number` | string | A unique reference number for the payment transaction. **Example:** `"asdDSADsdasdAGHSUUU"` |

**Example Request Body:**
```json
{
  "amount": 1684.51,
  "payment_method": "cash",
  "reference_number": "asdDSADsdasdAGHSUUU"
}
```

---

### Successful Response — `201 Created`

Returns a confirmation message and the recorded payment object.

```json
{
  "message": "Payment is recorded successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 14,
    "amount": 1684.51,
    "payment_method": "cash",
    "reference_number": "asdDSADsdasdAGHSUUU",
    "paid_at": "2026-02-28"
  }
}
```

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `message` | A human-readable confirmation string. |
| `data.id` | The auto-generated ID of the newly created payment record. |
| `data.amount` | The recorded payment amount. |
| `data.payment_method` | The payment method used. |
| `data.reference_number` | The reference number associated with the payment. |
| `data.paid_at` | The date the payment was recorded (format: `YYYY-MM-DD`). |

## Contract Summary

Retrieves a financial summary for a specific contract, including total invoiced amount, total paid, outstanding balance, invoice count, and the date of the latest invoice.

---

### Path Variables

| Variable | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | The unique identifier of the contract to retrieve the summary for. |

---

### Request Headers

| Header | Value | Description |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| `Accept` | `application/json` | Specifies that the response should be returned in JSON format. |

---

### Response — `200 OK`

Returns a financial summary object for the specified contract.

```json
{
  "message": "Contract Financial Summary Results",
  "data": {
    "contract_id": 3,
    "total_invoiced": "9121.35",
    "total_paid": "7103.31",
    "outstanding_balance": 2018.04,
    "invoices_count": 3,
    "latest_invoice_date": "2026-02-27"
  }
}
```

#### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `message` | string | A human-readable message describing the result. |
| `data.contract_id` | integer | The unique identifier of the contract. |
| `data.total_invoiced` | string | The total amount invoiced under this contract (as a decimal string). |
| `data.total_paid` | string | The total amount paid against this contract (as a decimal string). |
| `data.outstanding_balance` | number | The remaining unpaid balance (`total_invoiced - total_paid`). |
| `data.invoices_count` | integer | The total number of invoices associated with this contract. |
| `data.latest_invoice_date` | string | The date of the most recent invoice, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. |

## Get Authenticated User Details

Retrieves the profile details of the currently authenticated user. This endpoint returns information about the user associated with the active session or token.

---

### HTTP Method & URL

```
GET {{base_url}}user
```

---

### Request Headers

| Header   | Value              | Description                          |
|----------|--------------------|--------------------------------------|
| `Accept` | `application/json` | Specifies that the response should be in JSON format |

---

### Response Fields

| Field                | Type     | Description                                                                 |
|----------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `id`                 | integer  | Unique identifier of the user                                               |
| `name`               | string   | Full name of the user                                                       |
| `email`              | string   | Email address of the user                                                   |
| `email_verified_at`  | string   | ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the user's email was verified. `null` if not yet verified |
| `tenant_id`          | integer  | ID of the tenant the user belongs to (used in multi-tenant setups)          |
| `created_at`         | string   | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the user account was created                     |
| `updated_at`         | string   | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the user account was last updated                |

---

### Example Response

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "Ahmed",
  "email": "test@example.com",
  "email_verified_at": "2026-02-25T00:20:57.000000Z",
  "tenant_id": 1,
  "created_at": "2026-02-25T00:20:57.000000Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-02-25T00:20:57.000000Z"
}
```

## User Login

Authenticates a user with their credentials and returns a bearer token to be used for subsequent authenticated requests.

---

### Request Body

The request body must be sent as **raw JSON**.

| Field      | Type   | Required | Description                        |
|------------|--------|----------|------------------------------------|
| `email`    | string | ✅ Yes   | The registered email of the user.  |
| `password` | string | ✅ Yes   | The account password of the user.  |

**Example:**
```json
{
  "email": "test@example.com",
  "password": "password"
}
```

---

### Response

#### ✅ 200 — Success

Returns a success message, the authenticated user's details, and a bearer token.

```json
{
  "message": "User Logged in Successfully",
  "data": {
    "0": {
      "id": 1,
      "tenant_id": 1,
      "name": "Ahmed",
      "email": "test@example.com",
      "email_verified_at": "2026-02-25T00:20:57.000000Z"
    },
    "token": "6|gLwCCMp9RUQsypgEOpUeKhHDUewTAtGzouoyIo..."
  }
}
```

| Field                  | Type   | Description                                              |
|------------------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `message`              | string | Confirmation message indicating successful login.        |
| `data.0.id`            | integer| Unique identifier of the authenticated user.             |
| `data.0.tenant_id`     | integer| The tenant the user belongs to.                          |
| `data.0.name`          | string | Full name of the authenticated user.                     |
| `data.0.email`         | string | Email address of the authenticated user.                 |
| `data.0.email_verified_at` | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the email was verified.  |
| `data.token`           | string | Bearer token to be used for authenticating future requests. |

> **Note:** Include the returned `token` in the `Authorization` header of subsequent requests:
> ```
> Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
> ```
